# Employment Agreement

Contoso Analytics Inc. ("the Company") offers you the position of Research
Analyst.

1. Role. This is an ongoing, full-time role reporting to the Director of
   Research. Your set hours are 9:00 to 17:00, Monday to Friday.
2. Salary. Your salary is $6,000 per month.
3. Payment. You will submit an invoice for services each month; payment is
   made on receipt of the invoice.
4. Status. You are an independent contractor and responsible for your own
   taxes. The Company will issue a T4A at year end.
5. Benefits. The Company offers a group health plan to all employees.
